walkthroughs.body_html:
Software & Software Development — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Software & Software Development brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Software & Software Development.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the main advantage of asymmetric encryption?
options: Secure key exchange without sharing a secret in advance.
It is impossible to break.
It is faster than symmetric encryption.
Stored on a local computer rather than a server.

mcqs.q: What does inheritance allow a subclass to do?
options: It is impossible to break.
Reuse and extend the attributes and methods of its superclass.
Replace the superclass entirely.
Copy code from any unrelated class.

mcqs.q: What is the scope of a local variable?
options: Stored on a local computer rather than a server.
Accessible only within the function/block where it is declared.
Accessible everywhere in the program.
Copy code from any unrelated class.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Application software”?
options: System tools such as antivirus, disk defragmenter, file compression and backup.
Software whose source code is freely available to view, modify and distribute.
Programs that perform tasks for users, e.g., word processors, browsers, games.
Software that runs the computer itself, including the OS, drivers and utilities.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Firmware”?
options: System tools such as antivirus, disk defragmenter, file compression and backup.
Low-level software embedded in hardware, e.g., the BIOS or device controllers.
Software whose source code is freely available to view, modify and distribute.
Software that runs the computer itself, including the OS, drivers and utilities.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Utility software”?
options: Low-level software embedded in hardware, e.g., the BIOS or device controllers.
Software whose source code is freely available to view, modify and distribute.
System tools such as antivirus, disk defragmenter, file compression and backup.
Software whose source code is owned and kept private by its publisher.
